title: Spirit Turtle Subjugation Plan
paragraphs: “Motoyasu-san…”
Ren shrugged his shoulders slightly and replied with a sigh.
“Isn’t it fine? The Spirit Tortoise, to us now, is nothing more than… well, I wouldn’t say a pushover, but we can beat it to the point where it was never worth troubling Yuki in the first place.”
“…Understood. Then, Motoyasu-san, let’s take down the Spirit Tortoise in time for Yuki-san’s race. That way, there won’t be any problems.”
“If I recall correctly, Yuki-chan’s race is scheduled for the afternoon the day after tomorrow. Let’s defeat the Spirit Tortoise before then!”
“Understood! I, Motoyasu, will defeat the Spirit Tortoise and cheer on Yuki-chan as she races, as if nothing happened!”

A deadline has been set. For Yuki-chan’s sake and for the world, I decided to challenge the Spirit Tortoise faster than ever before. Father selected the personnel who would challenge the Spirit Tortoise. This time, the Queen would be accompanying us. However, since there wasn’t enough time to assemble a coalition army, we had to settle for the maximum number of people we could bring using the portal. Most of our companions were the Filolials we had raised.
“Sadeena-san and Larsa-san, you don’t have to participate.”
When Father subtly hinted that they didn’t need to come, the older sister cheerfully stepped forward and answered.
“What are you saying~? Your big sister is going to help~. It wouldn’t be right to leave everything to Naofumi-chan and the others~.”
“Then maybe we should sit this one out. It would be troublesome if we got injured, and I’m not sure it’s worth risking our lives.”
“It’s okay, Sasa-chan. We’re talking about Naofumi-chan, you know~?”

Come to think of it, Father had been leveling up at sea with the older sister. The older sister’s growth had been impressive, and Father said it had been quite entertaining. But the lack of fine-tuning was concerning. At the same time, Sakura-chan and Rival had leveled up considerably.
“Sadeena-san has gotten a lot stronger, but…”
“Well, I suppose if I’m with you guys, I’ll be fine. You’re going to pay well, right?”
“Of course. As you can see, we have the backing of both Melromarc and Faubrey.”
“Then, depending on the situation, I might run away, but I’ll join in.”
“Okay, got it. Then I’ll make sure to protect everyone so that Larsa-san and the others can’t run away. That’s all I can do.”
Hearing Father’s response, the older sister put her hand on her cheek with a serious look.
“Sa-Sadeena-san?”
“Naofumi-chan? You shouldn’t neglect yourself too much, okay? Sure, you say all you can do is protect us, but your big sister is worried about you, Naofumi-chan.”
“U-uh…”
“Everyone cares about Naofumi-chan. That’s why, Naofumi-chan, you shouldn’t throw away your life just to protect us, okay?”
“I-I understand, but… if I don’t do that, then what’s the point of me being here…”

Oh? Is it just my imagination, or does Father’s face look slightly red? As expected of the older sister. Of course, I would never allow such a situation to happen. I will slaughter the enemies before Father is ever put in danger.
“Naofumi-chan, you need to realize that being protected can sometimes be painful for the one being protected.”
“Y-yes…”
“I’ll do my best to be of help to you too, Naofumi-chan, so don’t try to stand at the front alone. Think about what magic is for. If we work together, we can protect Naofumi-chan as well.”
After saying that, the older sister let go of him.
Father looked at the older sister with a blank expression.
“So, I’ll be supporting Naofumi-chan with ritual magic~.”
“Come to think of it, the older sister is good at magic.”
If I recall correctly, she was unifying ritual magic and chant magic. Couldn’t the older sister fill the gap left by Yuki-chan?
“Then, older sister, can I ask you to lead the Filolials’ ritual magic?”
“Leave it to me! Your big sister will do her best. Sasa-chan, wouldn’t it be better for you to focus on unleashing your special attacks?”
“If I have the leeway, I’ll do it. But honestly, this tense atmosphere suits me better.”
Even the panda seems eager. Mercenaries must be creatures who seek excitement.
“Now, it’s the Queen’s turn.”
The Queen, who had been discussing matters with her soldiers, approached us.
“Kitamura-sama… Based on your experience, could you once again explain how the Spirit Tortoise was defeated?”
“Yes. In the first world, the Spirit Tortoise was defeated by taking down its head and the heart inside its body simultaneously.”
In truth, it was Father who somehow managed to defeat it. At that time, I was in hiding, fleeing from the Spirit Tortoise. The shock of those pigs escaping still lingers.
“However, last time, that didn’t work. Father analyzed that the conditions to defeat it increased because the seal on the Phoenix had been broken.”
“Hmm… Upon reviewing it again, having to defeat both the Phoenix and the Spirit Tortoise at the same time is…”
“With our current strength, we might barely be able to manage it.”
“True. But the seal on the Phoenix hasn’t been broken yet. If it does break, we’ll have no choice but to deal with it.”
“Simultaneously taking down the head and the heart… For now, I’d like to assess how strong the enemies on the outside are.”
“To us now, they’re just small fry.”
Last time, I blew the Spirit Tortoise’s head away multiple times, so I’m sure of it. With Ren and Itsuki here now, it would be harder for us to lose.
“I understand. So… let’s head out toward the Spirit Tortoise. When is the decisive battle expected?”
At Ren’s words, the Queen consulted her subordinates.

“If we continue advancing like this, we’re expected to encounter it by the morning of the day after tomorrow. However… there have been attacks by the Spirit Tortoise’s familiars, which had been lying in wait across various regions, and all the nations are struggling to respond.”

Come to think of it, a wounded dragoon came to report to the Queen. He was a soldier from a neighboring country and was attacked by the Spirit Tortoise’s familiars while delivering a message to Melromarc. It seems that communication systems are experiencing disruptions.
“That’s all the more reason to take down the Spirit Tortoise quickly. Motoyasu, if we defeat the Spirit Tortoise, the familiars should die as well, right?”
“I don’t know. However, in the first world where Father defeated the Spirit Tortoise, I didn’t see them afterward.”
“It’s frustrating that we can’t be sure.”
“There’s no helping it. Either way, we only have one thing to do.”
“Yeah. But this world is vastly different from the first one.”
Father stepped forward and spoke to Ren and Itsuki.
“We’re all here together. It’s not like before when I fought alone as a Hero. Ren, Itsuki, and Motoyasu-kun… this time, let’s defeat the Spirit Tortoise together!”
As Father declared that, I thought I saw the jewel in his shield gleam.
“Agreed. Then, let’s get going.”
“Yeah… Rishia-san, I’ll leave things to you while we’re away.”
“Bubue…! Bububu!”
Stalker Pig is waving at Itsuki with all her might. Isn’t she already completely Stalker Pig from the first world?
“Then, it’s time to depart! Portal Spear!”
Each of us took along the maximum number of people we could with our transfer skills and departed via the portal. Late that night…

We received a report from a neighboring country where the Spirit Tortoise had been sealed, informing us of its movements. After the seal was broken, it moved around trying to harvest all life within the country.
This part hasn’t changed from the previous time, has it? Afterward, it continued its course westward, as before. We still have some time before encountering it.
“Doesn’t it feel like you can hear footsteps from really far away?”
“Yeah… no doubt about it.”
“We might be able to see it soon.”

Currently, we are tracing the path of the Spirit Tortoise’s advance and camping in a plain along the way. We could have returned via portal to rest, but we chose to stay here so we would be ready to fight at any moment. After all, we can’t use the portal near the Spirit Tortoise. If we found ourselves unable to move on the morning of our departure tomorrow, it would be disastrous. Hearing the conversation between Father and the others, I perked up my ears. I can hear a distant, occasional thud from far away.
